HAPPINESS_FACTORS.VISIT_HAS_LACKED_DESC: The guest has not been able to visit a certain building and therefore incurs a greater decline in happiness. Once the corresponding need is fulfilled, their mood will slowly improve over time.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.WANDERINGMONKS_DELIVERY_HAPPINESSFACTOR_: You supplied food to the wandering monks.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.WANDERINGMONKS_UNDELIVERED_HAPPINESSFACT: You did not supply food to the wandering monks.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.MONASTERYTRADE_MERCHANT_BONUS_HAPPINESSF: You improved the likelihood of favourable negotiations with trade routes.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.MONASTERYTRADE_MERCHANT_MALUS_HAPPINESSF: You hindered the likelihood of favourable negotiations with trade routes.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_MALUS_HAPPINESSFACT: You failed to meet Abbess's expectations.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.FACTOR_MEAL_TAVERN_DESC: Your villager ate a delicious meal at the tavern! This Happiness bonus will fade over time.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.LABOURFAIR_GLOOMFAIR_HAPPINESSFACTOR_DES: The fair did not go as well as people hoped! Your folks are saddened over this failed event. Their mood will improve over time.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.LABOURFAIR_MERRYFAIR_HAPPINESSFACTOR_DES: The fair lived up to expectations! Your folks rejoice over this successful event, though the Happiness bonus will gradually fade.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPYGUESTS_HAPPINESSFACTOR_D: Some of the visitors had a great time and cheered up your villagers.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.LABOURFAIR_UNHAPPYGUESTS_HAPPINESSFACTOR: Some of the visitors had a terrible time and upset your villagers.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.ASPIRATION_KINGDOM_MALUS_HAPPINESSFACTOR: You failed to fulfil the King's demands.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.BUILDING_CITYBELFRY_HAPPINESSFACTOR_DESC: Your villager enjoys the privilege of living near the City Belfry! They gain a mood bonus that lasts as long as they reside nearby.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.ASPIRATION_LABOR_REWARD_HAPPINESSFACTOR_: The city charter gave your villagers their sovereignty.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.BUILDING_KNIGHT_STATUE_HAPPINESSFACTOR_D: Your Combatants take great pride in serving their realm! All Combatants receive a Happiness bonus so long as the Court of Heroes stands.

NEEDS.COULD_NOT_TRAIN: Could not practice with a training dummy!

STATUSES_DESC.STEWARD_DESC: The steward serves the Bishop in the interest of the Clergy.
STATUSES_DESC.ABBESS_ENVOY_DESC: The delegate speaks and conducts business for her liege, the Abbess.
STATUSES_DESC.WANDERING_MONK_DESC: Wandering monks preach the Faith across the realm.
STATUSES_DESC.PILGRIM_DESC: Pilgrims seek shelter as they travel around the realm.
STATUSES_DESC.ABBESS_DESC: The Abbess leads the esteemed nun abbey of Kinstone.
STATUSES_DESC.YOUR_KING_DESC: The King of the realm, your liege, to whom you owe allegiance and loyalty.
STATUSES_DESC.VISITING_KINGRETINUE_DESC: The King's retinue consists of their favourite advisors, courtiers, valets, and guardsmen.
STATUSES_DESC.VISITING_ROYALCOMPANY_DESC: Royal Companies are attended by the King's vassals as they fight on his behalf.
STATUSES_DESC.TRAVELER_DESC: Travellers seek lodgings to rest and replenish their supplies as they journey across the realm.
STATUSES_DESC.RETINUE_DESC: The retainer serves its liege by faithfully carrying out all his requests.
STATUSES_DESC.NOBLE_DESC: The noble rules over a domain bestowed upon them by the King.
